question: Is the axis engaged and functional at baseline and under a fixed oxidative challenge?
system: isogenic WWOX-deficient versus corrected human neuron-astrocyte cultures; clone and batch recorded, both KO clones kept; independent differentiations are the replicates
readout: nuclear NRF2 and KEAP1 protein, NQO1 enzyme activity, target transcripts, ROS reporter
controls: WT isogenic line; cell-type composition counted on the same wells; transcripts never stand for activity [Audit: the oxidative challenge is not named and there is no GSK-3 beta read-out.]
decision_it_changes: gate: if nothing differs and function is normal, the axis moves toward inert; if tone is lower or the response saturates, X1 is justified

question: Does acute NRF2 activation change the priority endpoint (network activity by multi-electrode array, with viability as co-endpoint)?
system: same cultures; acute or inducible perturbation to avoid developmental confounds
perturbation: KEAP1 knockdown (inducible); omaveloxolone; dimethyl fumarate; monomethyl fumarate as a separate arm; concentration and duration as variables, a series that spans the low and the high activity windows
readout: network activity, viability, NQO1 at each point to verify activation, free exposure where serum is present
controls: vehicle; NAC as one redox comparator (not proof of independence); two electrophiles are not two mechanisms [Audit: lacks post-treatment composition counts; KEAP1 knockdown also needs an NFE2L2-loss cross.]
decision_it_changes: whether arm R advances to a second model or is closed

question: Is the effect NFE2L2-dependent?
system: same, plus NFE2L2 knockout or inducible knockdown lines
perturbation: repeat X1 per compound in NFE2L2-intact and NFE2L2-deficient cultures; rescue with NFE2L2 re-expression
readout: same endpoint; residual effect in NFE2L2-deficient cells listed with explanation candidates (NF-kB, HCAR2 antagonist, GAPDH activity)
controls: genetic rescue; no new double-knockout animals unless a cell test cannot answer [Audit: does not say in which compartment NFE2L2 is lost.]

question: Is the benefit cell-autonomous or astrocyte-mediated?
perturbation: WWOX-null neurons with NFE2L2-intact or NFE2L2-null astrocytes, activation versus vehicle
readout: network activity of neurons; neuronal viability
controls: astrocyte purity; conditioned-medium control [Audit: lacks the NFE2L2-null-neuron arm with intact astrocytes.]

question: What can LEGEND still check without a laboratory?
system: existing deposits (organoid, shWWOX, P47T, neuron-targeted deletion)
perturbation: sourced NRF2-target panel fixed before looking; per-cell-type composition estimate; check that target scores track composition
readout: target panel score versus astrocyte/neuron markers per sample; ranges not significance claims
controls: panel taken from a cited source, never invented; n per sample reported
decision_it_changes: does not decide function; may sharpen what X0 must control
